subject: Quarterly Procurement Review – Action Required
body:
Dear Procurement Officer,

Please prepare a summary of all active tenders and pending requisitions for the quarterly review meeting scheduled for next Friday. Ensure all compliance documents are up to date.

Best regards,
Procurement Admin

subject: TEC Evaluation – Bidding Documents Ready
body:
Dear TEC Member,

The bidding documents for the IT Infrastructure tender are ready for your technical review. Please complete the evaluation within 5 working days as per the procurement timeline.

Thank you,
Procurement Officer

subject: Budget Utilization Warning – Applied Sciences
body:
Dear Head of Department,

This is to inform you that the Applied Sciences department has utilized 78% of its allocated annual budget. Please exercise caution in submitting new requisitions and prioritize critical items only.

Regards,
Bursar

subject: New E-Procurement Portal Guidelines for Suppliers
body:
Dear Valued Suppliers,

We are pleased to inform you that UWU has launched an updated e-procurement portal. All future bid submissions must be done through the online portal. Physical submissions will no longer be accepted after 2025-02-01.

Please update your profiles and ensure your digital signatures are registered.

Supplies Division
Uva Wellassa University

subject: Query Regarding Tender Specifications – TND-2024-001
body:
Dear Procurement Officer,

We would like to seek clarification on the technical specifications outlined in the tender document TND-2024-001. Specifically, regarding the RAM requirement – can we propose 32GB DDR5 as an alternative to the specified DDR4?

We look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Demo Supplier
SupplyTech Lanka (Pvt) Ltd

subject: RE: Query Regarding Tender Specifications – TND-2024-001
body:
Dear Demo Supplier,

Thank you for your query. After consulting with our TEC team, we confirm that 32GB DDR5 is an acceptable alternative to the specified DDR4, provided all other specifications remain compliant.

Please note this clarification applies equally to all participating vendors.

Best regards,
Procurement Officer
Uva Wellassa University

subject: University Procurement Policy Update 2025
body:
Dear Procurement Team,

Please be advised that the University Council has approved updates to the procurement policy effective January 2025. Key changes include:

1. Threshold for competitive tendering reduced to Rs. 500,000
2. All contracts above Rs. 5M require VC approval
3. Supplier registration must be renewed annually

Please ensure all staff are briefed accordingly.

Vice Chancellor
Uva Wellassa University

subject: Contract Signing – Required Documents
body:
Dear Supplier,

Congratulations on being awarded the contract. Please provide the following documents within 5 working days:

1. Company Registration Certificate
2. Tax Clearance Certificate
3. Performance Bond (10% of contract value)
4. Signed Contract Agreement (3 copies)

Please contact us to schedule the contract signing ceremony.

Contract Manager
Uva Wellassa University

subject: Payment Voucher Verification Complete
body:
Dear Contract Manager,

This is to confirm that the payment voucher for the first milestone payment has been verified and approved. The amount of Rs. 1,250,000 will be disbursed within 3 working days.

Finance Officer

subject: Reminder: Annual Procurement Plan Submission Deadline
body:
Dear Heads of Departments,

This is a reminder that the deadline for submitting your department's Annual Procurement Plan for FY 2025/2026 is 2025-03-31. Late submissions cannot be accommodated in the planning cycle.

Please coordinate with your respective faculties.

Supplies Division
